confidence_notes: The inspection found no API, so this script deliberately uses Playwright for the server-side OutSystems/WebForms flow and BeautifulSoup for rendered HTML parsing.
Pagination next-page behavior was not tested during inspection; the script follows the observed .ListNavigation_Next selector and waits for table content changes.

Listing column order and detail label/value structure were not fully enumerated. The script first uses discovered header labels and otherwise falls back to cell order; missing or differently labeled fields may be blank and should be reviewed in Flags.
No reviewer accordion or review PII was observed. The script does not expand accordions and applies masking if review-like text is nevertheless returned.
Input inspection specified a headerless Excel file. This script therefore reads header=None and interprets the first three positional columns as keyword, listing_url, and detail_url respectively.
The required independent detail_url path is implemented and uses DIRECT_INPUT as source_listing_url.
The product identifier strategy is consistent: the nr query parameter is used when present, otherwise a deterministic SHA-256-derived URL identifier is used.
The sample records contained future-looking 2026 dates relative to the inspection context; values are preserved exactly as rendered.
